gallery.alt: A sunlit voxel courtyard with striped stone arches, cypress and orange trees, a patterned zellige floor and a golden sphere on a fountain, seen from walking height.
gallery.caption: The Courtyard, a baked walkable world that runs in the browser.

gallery.alt: Aerial view of a voxel town square at golden hour, with tiled roofs, a clock tower and a crowd of small figures casting long shadows.
gallery.caption: One world at golden hour, the frame the BlockForge landing page tilts into.

gallery.alt: A painterly render of a towering rock citadel rising out of a turquoise sea under a blue sky with heavy clouds and distant mountains.
gallery.caption: The painterly concept art direction, rendered by the engine from a voxel world.

gallery.alt: Four views of the same small voxel park with a tree, a figure and a night-sky backdrop: plain 3D, Game Boy green, CRT and pixel 3D.
gallery.caption: One world, four looks: plain, Game Boy, CRT and pixel 3D.

gallery.alt: A dark, softly lit still life of a classical bust, three gold goblets, a blue and white vase, apples, a green bottle and a chess set on a table.
gallery.caption: The photoreal still life test, rendered by BlockForge.

gallery.alt: A night street of half-timbered houses with flower boxes and street lamps, where a boy in a blue coat walks beside a large orange fox.
gallery.caption: A frame from the Lamplighter short film.

gallery.alt: A white voxel castle with many blue conical roofs and turrets, surrounded by walls, gardens and pine trees under a bright sky.
gallery.caption: A castle built from a generator script through the CLI.

gallery.alt: A synthwave scene: a neon road runs over a magenta grid toward a striped setting sun, flanked by palm trees and wireframe mountains.
gallery.caption: The synthwave art direction applied to a generated scene.

blockforge.heroAlt: A painterly render of a deep jungle gorge with ruined stone arches, a waterfall down a mossy tower and sunlit cliffs, made by BlockForge from a voxel world.

turntables.alt: A long voxel steam train with a black locomotive, tender and coloured passenger carriages beside a station platform, turning slowly on a dark background.
turntables.caption: Grand Express train, exported to GLB and turned in three.js.

turntables.alt: A voxel rocket launch complex with a white rocket on its pad, a dark service tower, hangars and fuel tanks on an orange base, turning slowly.
turntables.caption: Display rocket and launch complex, exported to GLB and turned in three.js.

turntables.alt: A large voxel mansion with stepped brown roofs, cream walls, a courtyard pool and green hedges, turning slowly on a dark background.
turntables.caption: Mansion model, exported to GLB and turned in three.js.

models.alt: Voxel rocket launch complex, LOD1, quantized GLB (about 270 KB).
Voxel steam train, LOD2 GLB (about 80 KB).

gallery.alt: A dark canvas showing a circle with a right triangle inscribed on its diameter, labelled points and notes explaining that the angle at P stays 90 degrees.
gallery.caption: Woodr, the drawing language inside H, constructing relational geometry.

gallery.alt: A plotted parabola on dark axes with a secant line approaching the tangent and shaded rectangles under the curve.
gallery.caption: Woodr plotting a curve, a tangent and a Riemann sum.

gallery.alt: A hexagon, an eight-pointed star in a circle, and a small macro stamped three times, drawn in thin blue and green lines on a dark canvas.
gallery.caption: Woodr macros and iteration.

gallery.alt: Dark point-of-sale checkout screen with a barcode search bar, a cart of six bags of coffee beans with a bundle discount, cash payment selected and a change calculator in USD and Lebanese lira.
gallery.caption: Checkout with a bundle discount and a dual-currency change calculator (synthetic demo data).

gallery.alt: Reports and analytics dashboard showing total sales, revenue, realized profit, inventory health and a daily cash Z-report, each amount shown in dollars and lira.
gallery.caption: Read-only remote viewer reports (synthetic demo data).

gallery.alt: The same reports dashboard laid out right to left in Arabic, with the sidebar on the right.
gallery.caption: Full Arabic, right-to-left interface (synthetic demo data).

gallery.alt: Phone screen with the AnyThyng prompt "Describe it and this screen becomes it", a row of example app chips and a text box asking what you want.
gallery.caption: The AnyThyng home: describe an app in one sentence.

gallery.alt: Phone screen of a generated "Motor Proteins" app showing an interactive kinesin model walking along a microtubule, with labelled parts and controls.
gallery.caption: A generated interactive science app.

gallery.alt: Phone screen of a generated shop app with category filters and product cards with prices on a dark pink theme.
gallery.caption: A generated storefront app.

gallery.alt: Phone screen of a generated falling-block puzzle game called Brickfall, with a brick-textured board and on-screen controls.
gallery.caption: A generated puzzle game.

gallery.alt: A voxel hillside village of stone houses at dusk, lit windows scattered among trees and dark slopes behind.
gallery.caption: The stone village at night, from the short film WAR.

gallery.alt: A clean explainer frame on a cream background: a table of perimeters growing by four thirds next to a blue Koch snowflake outline.
gallery.caption: An animated explainer frame from the fractals film.

gallery.alt: A warm cream analytics dashboard with spending totals, a pie chart of spending by category and line charts of daily spending and budget against spending.
gallery.caption: Analytics: spending by category and budget tracking.

gallery.alt: A month calendar where each day lists small income and expense amounts, next to a financial planner panel.
gallery.caption: The calendar view of daily cash flow.

gallery.alt: A square social card on a purple and blue gradient with the name Housam Kak, a handle and a short line of text, laid out right to left.
gallery.caption: A generated post card in the right-to-left template.

gallery.alt: A square social card reading "The dragon flies on baked physics." with the caption 50,000 voxels, 100 frames, 60 fps.
gallery.caption: A generated hero card from a post brief.

gallery.alt: A square social card with a frosted glass panel holding a name, handle and short post on a dark purple gradient.
gallery.caption: The glass card template.

gallery.alt: A strip of simulation frames showing a small quadrotor carrying a screen circling a standing figure on a checkered floor.
gallery.caption: MuJoCo closed-loop turnaround, frame by frame.

gallery.alt: A strip of simulation frames of the hovering screen following a figure as it walks across a checkered floor.
gallery.caption: The screen tracking a walking user in simulation.

gallery.alt: Two versions of the same slide side by side: on the left an English left-to-right layout with arrows, a table and bar charts, on the right the mirrored right-to-left version.
gallery.caption: Before and after: a generic test slide mirrored for right-to-left.

gallery.alt: An Arabic slide before and after mirroring: the arrows, table columns and charts flip direction while the Arabic text and figures stay correct.
gallery.caption: Arabic text in a left-to-right layout, then correctly mirrored.
